name: Mountain Power Systems, Inc
old_description: Innovation is the fuel of this industry. Anyone can sell motor parts — we’re redefining how they’re sourced, delivered, and supported, every single day.
about:
Mountain Power Systems, Inc operates from Chapel Hill, North Carolina. The company describes itself as a small business that has been active for nearly a decade, built on decades of hands-on expertise in auto parts distribution. No founding year or founders are disclosed.

The firm specializes in distributing motor parts across industrial, agricultural, marine, and automotive sectors. It runs an eCommerce platform designed to streamline parts procurement, emphasizing automation in fulfillment and open data for customer experience. The company manages sourcing, delivery, technical support, procurement, product data, logistics, and customer care from its Chapel Hill facility.

Customers span industrial, agriculture, marine, and automotive industries. The company highlights cross-industry innovation: insights from its marine team inform agricultural solutions, while automotive demand shifts adapt the industrial pipeline. This approach aims to deliver unexpected solutions at competitive cost and speed.

Leadership states the business was started to redefine how motor parts are sourced, delivered, and supported. Differentiators include operating like a large enterprise despite small size, using eCommerce as a launchpad rather than a sales channel, and committing to transparency, integrity, and relentless iteration.

name: Mountain View Wood Works
old_description: Welcome to Mountain View, where creativity meets craftsmanship! We’re thrilled to invite you to experience our handcrafted and 3D Printed wonders firsthand at local craft shows and events near you.
about:
Mountain View Wood Works operates from Troy, Virginia, in the foothills of Central Virginia. The business is a small, father-and-son production shop that blends precision technology with handmade craftsmanship.

The shop specializes in CNC machining, laser engraving, and 3D printing, producing items such as award plaques, pantry organization can racks, custom signage, and home decor. It also offers custom design services and print-on-demand production for customer-supplied designs. The 3D printing arm, Mountain View 3D, is an authorized printer for several independent designers including Zou3D, Cinderwing, and Flexi Factory.

Customers include craft-show attendees, hobbyists, and organizations seeking personalized awards or signage. The company sells directly at local craft events and ships printed parts to clients who need rapid turnaround on 3D-printed tools, decor, and accessories.

The founders emphasize combining digital fabrication with the warmth of handmade work, offering quick production times and reliable shipping while maintaining quality across both wood and polymer outputs.

name: Mountaineer Home Medical
old_description: Delivering exceptional, professional service and care for 20+ years.
about:
Mountaineer Home Medical operates from Morgantown, West Virginia, where it has delivered in-home respiratory services for more than two decades. The company's founding year and original owners are not publicly disclosed, and no individual founders are named in available materials.

The firm provides home respiratory equipment and clinical services to patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, asthma, cystic fibrosis, chronic respiratory failure, and neuromuscular diseases. Its care model combines coordination with patients' medical teams, personalized education, custom care plans, and chronic disease management. Specific facility size, headcount, and service volumes are not published.

Mountaineer Home Medical serves individual patients in their homes and collaborates with clinical professionals such as physicians and respiratory therapists. The company's website highlights patient stories involving oxygen therapy, sleep apnea treatment, and mobility equipment, illustrating its role in post-acute and long-term respiratory care.

The organization states that its people, knowledge, technology, and community connections distinguish it in the home medical equipment sector. Its stated mission is to improve patient outcomes and inspire better lives through a highly effective home treatment model.

name: Mr R's Auto Salvage
old_description: Mr. R's Auto Salvage provides recycled, aftermarket, and rebuilt OEM body and mechanical parts through a network of partner facilities across the continental United States.
about:
Based in Buffalo, Wyoming, Mr. R's Auto Salvage has operated for more than 50 years as a supplier of recycled and aftermarket automotive components. The company's founding year and original owners are not disclosed in public materials.

The business distributes recycled, aftermarket, and rebuilt OEM body and mechanical parts through a network of partner facilities spanning the continental United States, with reach extending into North America, South America, and Europe. Its process centers on VIN or interchange-number matching to locate parts, followed by mechanic removal from donor vehicles, a detailed quality inspection and grading step, and secure packaging for pickup or shipment. The company advertises an inventory of over 80,000 parts and uses Pinnacle PRO yard management software to coordinate sales and logistics.

Primary customers are professional repair facilities, including collision centers and mechanical shops, though individual consumers also purchase through the online store. Reviews cite orders for items such as truck hoods, sunroof assemblies, center consoles, wiring harnesses, fuel doors, and complete engines, with both foreign and domestic vehicle coverage.

The company states its mission is to provide high-quality recycled, aftermarket, and rebuilt auto parts with integrity and efficiency, supporting professional repair facilities. Its vision aims for global leadership in the recycled auto parts industry through expanded reach, innovation, and sustainable automotive solutions. Stated values emphasize honesty, transparency, and a warranty-backed, easy-return purchasing experience.

name: Mtswoodworking
old_description: Our commitment to quality and the excellence of our finished products sets us apart.
about:
MTS Woodworking operates from Salem, New Hampshire, where the shop is run by craftsman Mike. The company focuses on custom furniture and woodworking for both residential and commercial clients.

The shop produces custom furniture pieces including bars, tables, kitchen islands, host stands, benches, and built-in nooks. Work is executed in solid hardwoods such as walnut and mahogany, with options for stone tops such as granite. The process begins with customer collaboration on design, followed by fabrication and finishing, including staining and wood treatments. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Customers range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind pieces to restaurant operators needing custom host stands, bars, and outdoor seating. Recent projects include a dark walnut bar and end table for a residence, a mahogany kitchen island with a granite top, a host stand for a restaurant, and an outdoor bench for a restaurant project.

The company states that its commitment to quality and the excellence of finished products sets it apart, emphasizing meticulous craftsmanship, avoidance of low‑quality materials for endurance, and unwavering attention to detail. A collaborative design approach is highlighted as central to bringing customer visions to reality.

Mubea Coil Spring Wire operates from Florence, Kentucky, as part of the global Mubea group. The company is led by CEO Thomas Muhr and follows a corporate philosophy known as "The Mubea Way," which emphasizes innovation, employee commitment, and customer focus. The group develops and manufactures components for vehicle chassis, car bodies, and engines, specializing in lightweight construction technologies that reduce weight and CO2 emissions. Specific facility size, production volumes, or part numbers for the Florence operation are not provided.

Mubea serves the automotive and aviation industries, as well as the emerging micro-mobility sector. The company positions itself as a partner for original equipment manufacturers in these sectors and also operates an aftermarket division, Mubea Aftermarket Services, supplying original spare parts.

The company states that its differentiation lies in deep in-house production expertise, a strategy of high value-added depth, and a culture that encourages employees to contribute ideas. Its products are designed to make vehicles more sustainable through weight reduction, and the organization highlights corporate social responsibility and sustainable production at its worldwide locations.

name: Muchmore Custom Plastics
old_description: Founded in Albuquerque, New Mexico, MCP started as a small operation, driven by a passion for craftsmanship and an eye for detail. Today, we proudly serve both local and national clients.
about:
Muchmore Custom Plastics, formerly known as Montiel's Custom Plastics, operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The family-owned business began as a small shop driven by a passion for craftsmanship and attention to detail, and has served local and national clients for nearly four decades.

The company specializes in custom plastic fabrication, offering design consultation, prototyping, production planning, and finishing services. Its capabilities include CNC cutting to a tolerance of ±0.060 inches, machining, beveling, polishing, and thermoforming of acrylic, polycarbonate, and other sheet plastics. Products range from museum-quality display cases and artist vitrines to sneeze guards, protective shields, lighting diffusers, and custom windshields for marine and recreational vehicles.

Clients span museums, art galleries, and collectors; laboratories, pharmaceutical, and medical facilities; lighting and electrical manufacturers; advertising and point-of-purchase display producers; universities, schools, and offices; hotels and restaurants; and recreational vehicle builders. The shop also serves frame shops, art supply stores, and individual inventors seeking custom plastic parts.

Muchmore emphasizes its family-owned heritage, premium material selection, and a reputation as a museum- and artist-preferred fabricator. The company cites its tight cutting tolerance and finished edges as key differentiators.

name: Municipal Truck Parts Inc
about:
Municipal Truck Parts Inc was founded in 1996 in Cheshire, Connecticut, and operates as an independent aftermarket truck parts retailer. The business is closely tied to the Davidson family, which contributes three generations of combined truck parts knowledge to the operation.

The company stocks a broad range of parts for trucks from one-ton capacity and up, including brakes, batteries, filters, exhaust, fluids, lighting, wipers, welding supplies, belts, fasteners, and safety equipment. A notable service is the on-site assembly of custom hydraulic, air, fuel, oil, and brake hoses, as well as battery cables, which are fabricated while the customer waits. Municipal Truck Parts also provides free daily delivery within a 25-mile radius of its Cheshire location.

Its customer base includes truck dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal fleets, and private companies throughout Central Connecticut. The firm represents a curated selection of manufacturers to ensure product quality and reliability.

The company’s longevity and focus on immediate hose fabrication are presented as key differentiators in the local market.

name: Murata Electronics North America, Inc.
old_description: Metal Terminal Type Common Mode Choke Coils for the '10Base-T1S' In-Vehicle Ethernet Standard
about:
Murata Electronics North America, Inc. is headquartered in Westborough, Massachusetts. The company operates as the North American arm of Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd., a global supplier of electronic components.

The division offers a broad portfolio of passive and active electronic components, including multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), inductors, noise suppression filters, TVS diodes, resistors, thermistors, sensors, timing devices, optical devices, sound components, power products, transformers, batteries, micro-mechatronics, RFID modules, printed circuit products, RF components such as baluns, couplers, filters, phase shifters, switches, front-end modules, acoustic wave devices, connectors, antennas, and connectivity modules. In addition to component manufacturing, Murata provides a product information management API covering 73 product categories, the SimSurfing simulation platform for component characterization, and application-specific solutions such as RFID systems for fashion, retail, healthcare, and manufacturing, as well as the efinnos renewable energy control solution.

Its customer base spans automotive, industrial, consumer electronics, healthcare, retail, and renewable energy sectors. Recent product announcements highlight automotive-grade components for CAN FD, ADAS, in-vehicle infotainment, and C-V2X communications, as well as components for humanoid robotics and AI infrastructure.

Murata emphasizes innovation in miniaturization and performance, citing achievements such as the world’s smallest 0201-inch three-terminal low-ESL MLCCs, the first 2.2 µF/100 Vdc soft-termination automotive MLCC in 0805 size, and mass production of automotive MLCCs with capacitance ratings. The company also underscores its commitment to simulation-driven design and comprehensive technical support through its online community and simulation tools.
